root: ^For hours now you've grown a bit bored. You can't leave the road out of view here in the forest, and most of your passengers are taking a nap. You envy them. But your boredom is mercifully taken out by a long van along the road. Smoke comes out of the engine, and as soon as they see you, they yell and wave there arms at you.

s: ^No time for that kind of mess.
^we're going to make a quick stop, everyone !

NoTime: ^You don't have the time nor the means to help these people. Soon they are but a fading memory left in your trail.
Stop: ^you stop a dozen meters after them. It's a group of ten people and a car loaded with anything they probably could take before leaving. One of them, a woman in a huge coat and visibly cold step clother and ask you “hi there ! Thank you for stopping, our car have an engine issue, can you help us please? If you can't repair it's ok, but would it be possible to tie the van to the back of your train? We promise to leave as soon as we can and to not be a disturbance.”
^Piotr lean toward you “I can look at it if you want, I will just need a bit of time and help”.

s: ^Sorry, we're already too heavely packed. Good luck.
^You said you can help them, let's do it then.

c-0: ^The woman, dazed by your words, looks at you with a mix of silent rage and heavy despair as you get back to the train and go away.
c-1: ^“oh thank you darling” the woman hold firmly your hands, moved by your kind heart.
^Everyone gather and help the family to get their van on the rail and tie to the last car.[when reach the next station]

^as you stop at the station, the lady with the coat descent from her van and approach you. “it was wonderful to travel with such nice people, mister. Thank you so much. she gives you a beautiful watch it belonged to my husband. I’m sure he would have been happy to see such a nice man wear it.
c-2: ^Piotr, spent a few hours looking, tinkering and testing with your help, until finally the roar of a functioning engine is drown by the cheering crowd.

^The woman kiss Piotr on the cheek and approach you “oh thank you a lot, I know it isn't much but it's all I can give you. Stay safe on the road my dear”. You say goodbye to the family and continue your journey, a smile on the face. Maybe this day isn't so boring after all.
